connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). INVERTED STACK: the lumped port integrates 0 -> driven_z_mm = 1.5525 mm (the line is on the INNER layer). Feed: EMBEDDED 50 ohm line (w 2.60 mm, y -13 -> -11.01, only 1.99 mm long) + embedded transformer (w 0.50 mm, l 7.80 mm, ~0.34 lambda_g at f0, NOT a quarter-wave: a matching section re-tuned on the de-embedded run-033 edge impedance) touching the radiating edge y=-3.21 (no inset, no notch). PENDING: a real connector needs a via/blind via to the inner layer or an edge launch on L2; the model does not include it.

feed.line_width_method: 2-D electrostatic finite-difference solve (own script, scratch only, /tmp; tensor grid dx 0.025-0.05 mm, dz = h/40 = 0.05175 mm, zero-thickness strip, open box 90 x 40 mm) of the buried microstrip at z = 1.5525 mm (eps_r 4.4 up to 2.07 mm, air above). w = 2.60 mm -> Z0 = 50.45 ohm (dx 0.025; 50.38 at dx 0.05), static eps_eff 3.728; f0 dispersion estimate ~3.83 (+0.1 as for the PS2 line; ROUGH). w = 2.65 would give 49.94 ohm but puts the line edge x = 1.325 mm 0.075 mm from the U-slot inner edge x = 1.4 mm: mesh grading x 1.70 > 1.5 (prepare trial), so 2.60 mm is used (0.4 ohm from 50; reflection ~0.4 %). Same solver at z_d = 1.29375 gives 88.54 / 4.028 (w 0.5) and 50.02 / 3.901 (w 2.1) vs the PS2 values 88.9 / 4.028 and 50.09 / 3.900. Estimate only; GEOMETRY_ONLY. The first EM run measures it.
feed.transformer_width_method: Same FD solver: w 0.50 mm (the project minimum feature) at z_d 1.5525 -> Zt = 96.56 ohm (dx 0.025), static eps_eff 3.843; f0 dispersion estimate ~3.88 (rough). Zt grows with z_d at fixed w (88.5 at 1.29375, 96.2-96.6 at 1.5525, 104.8 at 1.81125). Transformer length: NOT lambda_g/4 (4.5 mm); l = 7.8 mm from the robust re-match on the de-embedded run-033 patch-edge impedance (see computation.what_if_feed_rematch).

uslot_params.note: U-slot and patch identical in absolute dimensions and position to US3_PS2 (L 6.42, W 11.421, Wu 4.4, Lu 2.65, t 0.8, y0 -0.7). Only z_d, the 50 ohm line width and the transformer length change.

parasitic_params.note: Parasitic identical to US3_PS2 (top face z = 2.07, x +-5.7106, y -2.90..4.25, floating). The driven layer moves up to z_d = 1.5525 mm (gap 0.5175 = 2 mesh cells, driven-ground 1.5525 = 6 cells). y_min = -2.9 keeps it 0.31 mm clear (in projection) of the 0.5 mm transformer, which lies below it.

US3_PS2.family_of_change: COUPLING / FEED LEVEL of the driven layer: z_d (the tap ratio of the driven sheet to the top sheet) and, as its re-match, the transformer length. Documented EXCEPTION to 'one family': two intentional changes (see rationale); everything else is fixed.
US3_PS2.unchanged: patch 11.421 x 6.42 mm, U-slot (Wu 4.4, Lu 2.65, t 0.8, y0 -0.7), parasitic 11.421 x 7.15 mm at z 2.07, y -2.90..4.25, substrate FR4 eps_r 4.4 tan_delta 0.017 h 2.07, board 26 x 26 mm, metal, port (50 ohm lumped at y = -13, 0 -> z_d), mesh hint lines (x +-1.8, y -0.215)
US3_PS2.note: The 50 ohm line width is a DEPENDENT consequence of z_d (50 ohm at the new height), not a third change. The total feed length 9.79 mm (port y -13 to patch edge y -3.21) is unchanged, so the S11 reference plane is the same.

rationale: Ronda 33 (US3_PS2, openEMS base mesh, converged): S11 min -13.3 dB at 7.085 GHz, worst in channel -2.73 dB, eta 0.54 -> 0.69 -> 0.72, Re(Zin_port) 10-14 ohm and X +17..+20 ohm in the channel. DIAGNOSIS (data of run 033, GUIDE_MODEL de-embedding of the buried 50 ohm line + transformer to the patch edge; nothing here is a result). (1) The 7.07 GHz resonance is a parallel-type resonance at the patch edge (Re Z_edge peak ~255 ohm, X crossing + to -), its single-resonator circuit fit (em/fit_patch_circuit.py, 6.4-7.7 GHz) gives Q ~55 and R 73 ohm at the port, i.e. Q about 4x that of every single-patch run (13-27) and about equal to the dielectric Qd = 1/(tan_delta at 7.07 GHz = 0.0192) = 52: an energy-confined, loss-dominated mode. It is NOT the plain TM10 of the driven patch: a quasi-static covered-stripline estimate (own FD solve: driven sheet between ground and the top sheet, eps_eff 4.38, end extension 0.37 mm per end, U-slot term 0.914 mm from MS3) puts that mode at ~8.9 GHz, 1.8 GHz above the observation; the most likely candidates are the U-slot / driven-plate mode enclosed in FR4 (slot length ~9.7 mm ~ lambda_g/2 = 10.1 mm at eps_eff 4.38 and 7.07 GHz) or a coupled mode of the pair; the radiation of this mode was NOT simulated (NF2FF only in the channel), so 'dark' is an inference from Q ~ Qd, not a measurement. The guide's isolated driven target (8.28 GHz) was therefore the wrong mode assignment: the pair does not form the two nearby channel resonances the guide assumed (expected dips 7.89 / 8.25 GHz). (2) The ~8.06 GHz feature is the bright, top-sheet (parasitic-dominated) mode: the FD estimate for the 7.15 mm top sheet alone (eps_eff 3.66, end extension 2.69 mm total) is 7.96 GHz vs 8.06 observed, the guide had 8.20; it radiates normally (eta 0.72 at 8.24 GHz, as P01_MS1 0.75) and sits in the middle of the channel. It is however weakly coupled to the port: Re Z_edge only ~30 ohm and X_edge ~ +50 ohm in the channel (Re Zin_port 14 ohm), while the quarter-wave transformer needs R_edge ~ Zt^2/50 = 158 ohm. (3) Scale argument: a driven sheet at height z_d under a top sheet taps the bright mode with V_d/V_top = alpha (FD modal solve: alpha 0.583 at z_d 1.29375, 0.712 at 1.5525, 0.851 at 1.81125, even-mode eps_eff constant 3.67), so R_edge(bright) ~ alpha^2 R_top: 0.34 R_top = 30 ohm gives R_top ~ 88 ohm (the bright mode is not intrinsically unmatched, the tap ratio is too low). (4) What a FEED-ONLY retune can do: re-applying a transformer of any (Zt <= 88.9, l) to the de-embedded Z_edge(f) gives at best -5.5 dB worst in channel (Zt 87.5-88.9, l ~7.9 mm; guide error up to ~3 dB, validated only qualitatively in round 27): not enough for the -6 dB minimum. A common rescaling of L_driven and Lp is NOT indicated: the bright mode is already at 8.06 GHz (= 7.99 GHz in the HFSS frame), and pushing the confined 7.07 GHz mode into the channel would reproduce the PS1 loss-matching (eta valley). CHOICE: raise the driven sheet to z_d = 1.5525 mm (6 mesh cells; gap to the top sheet 0.5175 mm = 2 cells): alpha 0.583 -> 0.712, expected R_edge(bright) x1.49 ~ 45 ohm (tap model; if the reactance scales too, X also x1.49) and, because Zt of the 0.5 mm line grows with z_d (96.6 ohm) and the transformer is re-matched to the new, higher edge impedance, the guide predicts -6.3 .. -10 dB worst in channel over the uncertainty cases (R scale 1.25-1.75, X scale 1 or R scale), against -5.5 dB for the best feed-only retune of the old stack. This is a DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION to 'one family': (a) z_d is the lever on the bright-mode port coupling, (b) the transformer length must be re-derived because the impedance it matches changes (and the new 50 ohm line width is dependent on z_d); they cannot be separated without wasting the last refinement. z_d was the pre-registered REFINEMENT-2 lever of PS2 ('split too small -> more coupling'); using it now leaves, as the final refinement, only the calibrated tuning of l / Lp with this run's de-embedded Z_edge. Everything else (patch, U-slot, parasitic, substrate, board, port, mesh hints) is kept. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, gain, efficiency, bandwidth or phase is claimed.

computation.label: GUIDE_MODEL (geometric/quasi-static estimate fitted to / derived from run US3_PS2_OPENEMS_033 EM data, NOT an EM result for US3_PS3)
computation.method: (a) De-embedding: from s11_wideband.csv of run 033 (Zin at the lumped port, y = -13) the 50 ohm line (Z0 50.09, eps_eff 3.90 static -> 4.0 at f0, 4.09 mm) and the transformer (Zt 88.9, eps_eff 4.028 -> 4.06, 5.7 mm) are removed analytically as ideal lossless TEM lines (em/feed_retune_guide.line; junction step, open end, losses ignored) to get Z_edge(f). (b) Re-match: a transformer (Zt, l) and a 50 ohm line are re-applied to Z_edge(f) (and to Z_edge with its real part scaled by s = (alpha'/alpha)^2) and the channel worst S11 is read on a 1 MHz-class grid (7.3-8.7 GHz data grid, em/feed_retune_guide.channel_metrics); l chosen to minimise the maximum worst-case over 6 uncertainty cases (s 1.25 / 1.49 / 1.75, X scale 1 or s). (c) 2-D electrostatic finite-difference solves (own script, scratch only; validated: reproduces PS2 line widths 88.54 / 4.028 and 50.02 / 3.901 vs 88.9 / 4.028 and 50.09 / 3.900) for Z0 / eps_eff of the buried lines at z_d 1.5525, and a coupled-strip modal solve (generalised eigenproblem C v = lambda C_air v) of the stack ground / driven sheet / top sheet (strip width 11.4 mm) for the modal eps_eff and the voltage ratio alpha. (d) Single-resonator fit of run 033: em/fit_patch_circuit.py on 6.4-7.7 GHz. A two-resonator coupled circuit (capacitive coupling, 9 parameters, 120 random starts) did NOT converge to an identifiable solution (rms 4.5 ohm, parameters at bounds/degenerate): not used.

inputs.run: em/US3_PS2_OPENEMS_033 (EM_SIMULATED, openEMS 0.37.0.post1.dev40, base mesh, 60000 steps, lumped port at y -13)

z_edge_deembedded_ohm.note: model-dependent: a +-5 % error in eps_eff of the 0.5 mm line moves X by a few ohm; junction and open-end reactances are lumped into X

outputs.transformer_l_electrical_deg_f0: ~151 (lambda_g(3.88) = 19.06 mm at f0; NOT a quarter wave: it transforms the inductive edge impedance, not a purely real one)

what_if_feed_rematch.label: GUIDE_MODEL what-if, NOT EM; worst |S11| in 7.7376-8.2368 GHz
what_if_feed_rematch.old_stack_feed_only_best: -5.53 dB (Zt 88.9, l 7.9 mm; fallback if z_d change is rejected)
what_if_feed_rematch.model_error: up to ~3 dB mean in-channel and >5 dB locally (validator, round 27, qualitative only); the s-scaling is the unverified assumption of the tap model

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Same protocol as run 033 (openEMS base mesh, --edge-port lumped, NF2FF 11 points, fc 2.5 GHz, --max-timesteps 60000, converged to the energy criterion): worst |S11| over 7.7376-8.2368 GHz (1 MHz grid) is <= -6 dB (run 033: -2.73 dB; guide: -6.3 .. -10 dB; the preferred -10 dB is not expected).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: Radiation efficiency Prad/Pacc >= 0.6 at all 11 NF2FF channel frequencies (run 033: 0.54 -> 0.72) and no valley below 0.5, Dmax within 20 deg of broadside at all of them (run 033: 15-20 deg).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H_mechanism: The tap-model prediction, tested on the SAME de-embedding recipe (line 50.45 ohm eps_eff 3.83 and transformer 96.56 ohm eps_eff 3.88 at f0): (i) Re Z_edge at the bright mode (~8.0 GHz) rises from ~30 ohm to 37-52 ohm; falsified if < 34 or > 60 ohm. (ii) the bright mode stays at 8.06 +- 0.08 GHz (even-mode eps_eff unchanged 3.67 -> 3.674); falsified otherwise. (iii) the 7.07 GHz high-Q mode (Q ~55) is still outside the channel (no S11 minimum below -10 dB with Q > 30 inside 7.74-8.24 GHz); its new frequency is recorded as a diagnostic, no value is predicted.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H3_null: If an eta valley below 0.5 appears in the channel with S11 good (matching by loss) the confined mode entered the channel: stop changing the geometry of this architecture and run the tan_delta = 0 control of the PS1 geometry (owner decision recorded in PS2).
pre_registered_hypothesis.evidence_rule: Nothing here is a result. A single base-mesh openEMS run only tests the hypotheses; HFSS is needed to validate. PS3 is not reviewed by design-reviewer yet.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: REFINEMENT 2 (the LAST allowed for this candidate; one family, calibrated on the PS3 run, no blind sweeps; design-reviewer only if the owner agrees to simulate in HFSS). (A) H1 and H2 hold -> no further geometry change: fine mesh (two-mesh rule), then owner decision on HFSS. (B) Mechanism confirmed (i, ii hold) but H1 fails by < ~3 dB -> change ONLY the transformer length l (and, if |X| residual demands, w) from the PS3 de-embedded Z_edge with the same guide (calibrated; sensitivity ~1 dB per 0.4 mm). (C) Bright mode shifted by > 80 MHz from 8.06 GHz but mechanism (i) holds -> common shift of L_driven and Lp together (slopes -9.0 / -8.4 MHz per 0.01 mm) re-calibrated on the measured mode. (D) Mechanism (i) falsified (Re Z_edge < 34 ohm): the tap model is wrong; revert to z_d = 1.29375 and apply the feed-only retune of PS2 (guide -5.5 dB best, l ~7.9 mm) as the last refinement, accepting that PS2/PS3 cannot reach -6 dB, or stop the architecture. (E) eta valley < 0.5 with good S11 -> H3_null: stop. Do not change z_d and Lp / L_driven in the same round.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers: L1 top (floating parasitic sheet, z=2.07 mm), L2 INNER (driven patch with U-slot + 50 ohm line + transformer, z=1.5525 mm), L3 ground (z=0). 2 dielectric layers: 1.5525 mm (ground-L2) + 0.5175 mm (L2-L1). A standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer; the exact core/prepreg split is the fabricator's (a 0.5175 mm prepreg is thinner than the PS2 0.776 mm; to be checked with the fabricator).
manufacturability.connector: PENDING. The line is on the inner layer: an SMA/edge launcher on L1 would need a (blind) via from L1 to L2 or a cut-out/edge launch contacting L2; none is modelled (lumped 50 ohm port 0 -> z_d at the board edge y=-13). Via/launch parasitics and the inner-layer reference plane are not included.
manufacturability.vias: none in the model (the parasitic floats on L1; no feed via).
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: transformer 0.50 mm wide (exactly the project minimum; +-0.05 mm etch moves Zt by ~+-2.5 ohm) and 7.8 mm long (a long narrow high-Z track, loss and etch sensitive); U-slot arms/base 0.8 mm as MS3; copper to slot edge >= 1.26 mm (top arms to patch edge), >= 3.5 mm in x; parasitic is a solid rectangle. Not checked against any fabricator.
manufacturability.geometry_checks: patch +-5.7106 x +-3.21 mm, U x +-2.2 / y -0.7..1.95 (unchanged), line x +-1.30 / y -13..-11.01, transformer x +-0.25 / y -11.01..-3.21, parasitic x +-5.7106 / y -2.90..4.25: all inside the 26 x 26 mm board; line and transformer do not cross the slot; the parasitic does not overlap the line or transformer in projection (0.31 mm clearance in y); line edge x 1.30 mm is 0.10 mm from the U-slot inner edge x 1.4 mm in projection only (different y ranges, no overlap); dielectrics 1.5525 mm (ground-L2) + 0.5175 mm (L2-L1).
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: dielectric thickness ground-L2 (z_d; ~30 ohm/mm on Zt, alpha 0.58->0.71 per 0.26 mm so R_edge ~ +-12 % per 0.05 mm), L2-L1 gap (coupling), layer registration, etch of the 0.5 mm transformer (7.8 mm: +-0.05 mm -> Zt +-2.5 ohm) and of Lp/L_driven (~9 MHz per 0.01 mm), real eps_r/tan_delta of core and prepreg (may differ).
manufacturability.risks: homogeneous FR4 is provisional; the stack split is the fabricator's; a floating sheet and an inner-layer line cannot be tuned after lamination; inner-layer connector transition unresolved; the confined 7.07 GHz mode may move toward the channel when z_d changes (not predicted).

purpose: Refinement 1 of the inverted classic stack (US3_PS2): raise the driven U-slot sheet to z_d = 1.5525 mm and re-match the buried transformer so that the bright top-sheet mode at ~8.06 GHz is coupled to the 50 ohm port, based on the run-033 data.
mesh_hint_note: Hint lines identical to US3_PS2 (x +-1.8 mm, y -0.215 mm). prepare trial (round 34): line w 2.65 (edge x 1.325, 0.075 mm from the slot edge 1.4) fails x grading 1.70 > 1.5; w 2.60 passes with max neighbour ratio 1.43 (x), 1.39 (y), 1.33 (z). z lines at 1.5525 and 2.07 coincide with the substrate lines (h/8 = 0.25875 mm).
